## What you did
- Polished the v2 dashboard widgets in PR #427 — compact 40px widget header on design tokens, readable retention labels ("Week of Nov 2"), a loading skeleton that removes the chart jump, and a categorical cohort palette — then checked it on staging with the Orbitly workspace [1].
- Reworked the dashboard CSV export (#424) into a background job: the endpoint returns 202, rows are streamed into a gzipped file, and a signed 24h link is emailed; the v1 button now confirms instead of spinning. PR #430 opened for Daniel [2].
- Set up the `dashboards_v2` per-workspace flag with a 12-column draggable grid, scoped so Orbitly gets it first [3].

## What changed
- Daniel approved #430 (streaming + 202) — merge once CI is green. That's also the answer Rachel needs for Zest, who asked again this morning ahead of their Monday ops review [5][6][9].
- Maya answered your chartkit question on #427: code is fine, ship v2 behind the flag, but keep `@chartkit/react` until v1 is gone [7].
- Dependabot opened #429 bumping `@chartkit/react` to 5.0.0 — a major with a new tooltip API and dropped legacy browsers — which matters since v1 stays on chartkit [4].

## What is still open
- Priya's rollout blocker on KES-512: the CSV export is gone from the v2 widget menu, and the Orbitly flag can't go on Thursday without it — it needs to come back on top of the new background export [10].
- The `RetentionChart` tooltip still crashes on empty cohorts (line 212), as you left it last night; Sentry already has 37 events from 4 users on staging, and staging has to be solid by Wednesday [1][8].
